units.source_text: 按通常说法，抱一个孩子来抚养，便会给这家带一个孩子来，夫妇俩就会生下亲生骨肉。

en.t: According to the usual saying, if a couple took in a child to raise, that child would bring another child into the household, and the couple would have a child of their own.

units.source_text: 可是，阿繁没有怀上孩子。

en.t: But Shige did not become pregnant.

units.source_text: 千重子就作为太吉郎他们的独生女，受到抚育和宠爱。

en.t: So Chieko was raised and cherished as the only daughter of Takichiro and his wife.

units.source_text: 随着岁月的流逝，太吉郎夫妇也不再为这孩子究竟被谁遗弃而烦恼。

en.t: As the years passed, Takichiro and his wife no longer troubled themselves over who had abandoned the child.

units.source_text: 至于千重子的亲生父母是死是活，更无从知晓。

en.t: As for whether Chieko's birth parents were alive or dead, there was even less way to know.
